intro.p1: This is the central hub for the Unforgettable Eternal Project (UEP). Here you'll discover my technical projects, creative works, and the expansive fictional universe I've been building.

bio.p1: I'm Bernie, a passionate developer and creative storyteller behind the Unforgettable Eternal Project (UEP).
bio.p2: I combine technical expertise with creative writing to build unique digital experiences and expansive fictional worlds. Whether it's coding elegant solutions or crafting intricate narratives, I strive to create work that resonates and endures.
bio.p3: This website serves as the central hub for all my projects, from technical portfolios to creative writings and world-building documentation.
